sequence_description: I5 attack: Use a control SAML login, then attempt SAML login with an expired assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past). If accepted, authentik grants a session beyond upstream temporal intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: authentik accepted an expired SAML assertion, granting a session beyond upstream temporal intent (NotOnOrAfter not enforced).
